answer_2.quote: We evaluate our models using the official distractor dev-set as our test set.

answer_3.quote: Beyond efficiency and empirical gains, DSR enables fine-grained relational retrieval. By explicitly modeling explanatory relations between (q, a) pairs and supporting passages, our approach lays the foundation for specialized retrievers (e.g., causal, temporal, comparative) and provides a mechanism for grounding the reasoning of large language models (LLMs).

answer_4.quote: Each question-answer pair in FocusQA is accompanied by four context types: title question context (TQC), paragraph question context (PQC), title answer context (TAC), and paragraph answer context (PAC).
answer_4.guideline: We evaluated our models using the official distractor dev-set.
